meta.title: Small Hours — an essayist’s site
meta.description: A writer’s site built by gogh: the latest essay set large, the archive as a ruled ledger, eight essays with their own dates, and a posts page in the ledger look. It opens in the writing room on the newest essay.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'gogh_booted_as', 'essayist' );
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
wp_update_user( array( 'ID' => 1, 'display_name' => 'Maud Ellery', 'first_name' => 'Maud', 'last_name' => 'Ellery' ) );
wp_update_term( 1, 'category', array( 'name' => 'Essays', 'slug' => 'essays-all' ) );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
$def = json_decode( base64_decode( '' ), true );
if ( is_array( $def ) && function_exists( 'gogh_site_def_boot' ) ) {
	try { gogh_site_def_boot( $def ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
}
